name: haxiom
description: Haxiom is a secure, sandboxed Haxe-in-Haxe interpreter, scripting engine and bytecode Virtual Machine (VM)
releasenote: 1.0 alpha: VM-first execution, stack-safe bytecode recursion, hardened HXBC persistence, typed interface proxies, sandboxed static initialization, instance-isolated runtime state, and private internal APIs
